ops.doc: Variance of orders placed over variance of customer demand.

ops.name: Factory order variance

ops.name: Factory bullwhip
ops.doc: Variance of orders placed over variance of customer demand.

ops.name: Factory average backlog

ops.name: Chain window cost
ops.equation: Retailer window cost + Wholesaler window cost + Distributor window cost + Factory window cost

ops.name: Chain cost
ops.equation: Retailer cost + Wholesaler cost + Distributor cost + Factory cost

ops.name: Fill rate

ops.name: Equilibrium gap
ops.equation: IF THEN ELSE(Week < Step week, IF THEN ELSE(Use equilibrium S prime = 1, ABS(Retailer orders placed - Base demand) + ABS(Wholesaler orders placed - Base demand) + ABS(Distributor orders placed - Base demand) + ABS(Factory orders placed - Base demand), 0), 0)
ops.doc: Total distance of the orders from equilibrium before the step, when the equilibrium desired stock is in use (T2).

ops.name: Amplification holds
ops.equation: IF THEN ELSE(Retailer peak order < Wholesaler peak order, IF THEN ELSE(Wholesaler peak order < Distributor peak order, IF THEN ELSE(Distributor peak order < Factory peak order, 1, 0), 0), 0)
ops.doc: 1 if the highest order grows at every stage going upstream (T3).

ops.name: Peaks later upstream
ops.equation: IF THEN ELSE(Retailer peak time <= Wholesaler peak time, IF THEN ELSE(Wholesaler peak time <= Distributor peak time, IF THEN ELSE(Distributor peak time <= Factory peak time, IF THEN ELSE(Retailer peak time < Factory peak time, 1, 0), 0), 0), 0)
ops.doc: 1 if the highest order comes no earlier at each stage going upstream, and strictly later at the factory (T3).
